correctness.rationale: For each nonzero graph sum under APN, exactly one unordered distinct pair contributes twice; the entire zero fiber is the diagonal and has coefficient T=Σ f(t)^2. Plancherel yields q² M4=|T|²+2(S²−Q). Two universal complex algebra pair identities make the deficit an SOS and force scalar sign extremizers. For a nonAPN map, multiplicity m≥2 adds at least 8 to the unnormalized constant-input energy. Gold cubic t³ is APN in every binary field. A standard-library checker validates exact collision counts, exhaustive maps for q=2,4, complex Walsh agreement and SOS over q=2,4,8,16,32.

value.rationale: The theorem completes a natural sharp fourth-moment variational problem for every binary APN graph, produces a global exact pairwise stability certificate, and identifies every complex optimizer (2^(q−1) projective classes) rather than just constant-amplitude witnesses. It quantitatively separates non-APN graphs by a norm gap at least 8/q². The phase rigidity is characteristic-specific and contrasts with familiar odd-characteristic extension families. The proof is short and uses well-known APN/Sidon premises, which is accurately disclosed.
